summary: Specifies the MPLS base YANG data model, a framework for configuring and managing the MPLS switching function on a router. Other MPLS-related YANG models, such as those for static LSPs, LDP, or RSVP-TE, are expected to build on it.

eli5.summary: A standard settings form for the part of a router that forwards packets by labels, so management tools from different makers can all fill it in.

questions: how to configure mpls with netconf
